assertions.subject: cervical radiculopathy
assertions.quote: The Spurling test—performed by applying axial compression while extending and rotating the neck toward the symptomatic side—serves as one of the most specific assessments for cervical radiculopathy

assertions.subject: Neuropathy
assertions.quote: Motor strength testing in key myotomes—C5 (deltoid and biceps), C6 (wrist extensors), C7 (triceps), C8 (finger flexors), and T1 (interossei)—helps identify lower motor neuron weakness
